source: Codex 2026-11-18. Prospective protocol for the independent post-freeze exam.
target: semantic.nearest_inheritance.v1, nearest property evidence within 3 parent edges
extra_policy: First four HELDOUT items of each world in committed public file order; no performance-based selection.
plain_base: Original system and user text without optional fixed memory suffix. Baseline for scaffold-cost diagnosis only.
matched_baseline: BASE has the same fixed blank memory suffix as every injected arm. The primary causal comparison uses BASE.
novelty: Post-freeze random world/graph identifiers, property names, values, facts, order, and seed. Synthetic graph families/prompt grammar share the tested semantics; domain transfer to unconstrained natural language is outside this design.
isolation: Examiner scripts import no student code. Public file excludes truth and seed. Submission SHA is fixed after greedy generation and before LL teacher forcing and independent scoring. Same-machine role/file separation, no OS access-control guarantee.
freeze: Immutable source commit; SHA-256 for student, gate, config, tokenizer, model, calculator, scorer, generator and protocol, logged before seed creation.
development: Public packaged examples plus synthetic development graphs, separately named validation graphs. Select layer/alpha on development accuracy; fit activation gate from development labels. Validation descriptive. No hidden calibration.
exact: strip surrounding whitespace, Unicode casefold, remove one terminal .!?。！？ codepoint, rstrip whitespace, compare entire strings; failures score zero.
likelihood: Teacher-forced sum of natural-log probabilities of all target suffix tokens using tokenized rendered prompt + exact expected answer. No explicit leading space or BOS, no EOS in target. Verify prefix IDs are unchanged; also report -sum/Ntokens. Use the original next-token shift and same frozen gate decision as greedy.
paired_inference: Two-sided per-arm Wilson 95% for accuracy; paired case bootstrap with replacement, deterministic seed 841277, 4000 replicates and percentile 95% for accuracy deltas. Raw 2x2 transition counts and case IDs. Exploratory engineering thresholds.
p0: Real nonzero hidden change, next block consumes the changed values; identical weight SHA before and after.
p2: Count forced and gated triplets separately. Exact generated IDs, text and SHA-256 of first-step logits for ON/RESTORE and ZERO/BASE. Match gate decision, capsule, model, codec, layer, locus, strength, prompt and decode. Check expected inactive interventions separately from active. Wrong capsule and field effects are required to interpret specificity.
p4: P1 benefit in both worlds, report general-control paired deterioration including whether any general item actually received an intervention.

levels.I1: Actual gains decoding multiple previously unseen complete multi-token values
levels.I2: Field distinguishability plus causal evidence of appropriate use beyond answer-value transfer
levels.I3: Controlled evidence of model contribution on incomplete inference state

diagnostics: field ablative effects on matched HELDOUT subset
p50/p95 request latency and GPU peak
developer probe on same value with differing evidence
post_freeze: No tuning against either hidden world. Preserve all raw predictions, likelihoods, failures and examiner commitments. Gate metrics are descriptive if forced transmission fails.
